raw_segments.text: At once, as far as angels can, he views the dismal situation waste and wild, a dungeon
horrible on all sides round as one great furnace flamed, yet from those flames no light, but
rather darkness visible served only to discover sights of woe, regions of sorrow, doleful
shades, where peace and rest can never dwell, hope never comes that comes to all, but torture
without end still urges, and a fiery deluge, fed with ever-burning sulfur unconsumed.
